nodes.label: intraday-research-v1
nodes.rationale: A deterministic, unvalidated alert-following model produces conditional price levels and hypothetical size without orders or portfolio management. Original output is immutable; current reanalysis is separate. Synthetic validation does not establish historical profitability or trading readiness.

nodes.label: Frozen planning inputs and original receipt provenance
nodes.rationale: Inputs come only from frozen alert row/session/identity and original event/receipt timestamps. Require matching identities, contiguous completed minutes and quotes at most five seconds old. Current SIP sizes are shares; unverified conversions withhold sizing instead of inventing capacity.

nodes.label: Decimal geometry and robust partial-fill sizing
nodes.rationale: Minute ATR defines rounded entry/stop/target geometry and expiry. Whole-share size is bounded by cash, risk, notional and observed liquidity using nonnegative affine fees. A lower-entry, one-share-partial reward/risk gate precedes positive size; complete confirmed account context expires after five minutes.
